with_sayso.precision-plain: Precision measures the proportion of positive predictions that are correct, while recall measures the proportion of actual positive cases that the model identifies. When the model predicts a positive case, precision is the share of those predictions that are right; when a case really is positive, recall is the share the model finds. One can be high while the other is low, because each proportion is taken over a different set of cases.

with_sayso.cache-before-status: Check the HTTP status before caching a response, and do not cache one that failed. Caching an HTTP error may cause later calls to reuse that failed result.
with_sayso.threshold-sentence: Raising the decision threshold for the positive class leaves recall the same or lower when recall is defined: it falls if at least one true positive is reclassified as negative and stays the same otherwise. Precision depends on which predicted positives fall below the new threshold and on whether any remain: it is undefined if none remain; otherwise it rises when the true-positive share of the removed predictions is lower than the previous precision, falls when that share is higher, and stays the same when that share is equal or no prediction is removed.

without_sayso.precision-plain: Precision measures the proportion of positive predictions that are correct, while recall measures the proportion of actual positive cases that the model identifies. Precision asks how often the model is right when it predicts a positive result, and recall asks how many of the real positive cases it successfully finds. A model can score high on one and low on the other, so both are needed to judge its performance.

without_sayso.threshold-sentence: Raising the decision threshold for the positive class leaves recall unchanged or lowers it, because an actual positive is counted only when its score still clears the cutoff, and a higher cutoff can only drop positives out. Precision can rise or fall with that same change, depending on whether the instances whose scores sit between the two thresholds are mainly false positives or mainly true positives.
